status: Draft weights only — owner approval and manager review required
primary_goal: Earn a qualified service request or a truthful agreed next step for a non-fit or unresolved policy.

categories.title: Greeting and professionalism
categories.coaching: Name L&L and invite the caller to explain their need. Vocal tone requires listening evidence.

categories.title: Structured discovery
categories.coaching: Ask about property, size, rooms, condition, pets, frequency, extras, timing and location before price.

categories.title: Listening and relevant value
categories.coaching: Reflect the stated need and acknowledge the concern. A selected script does not prove spontaneous empathy.

categories.title: Objection handling
categories.coaching: Acknowledge, clarify, answer the actual concern using confirmed facts, then check understanding.

categories.title: Closing and accurate handoff
categories.coaching: Ask for the appropriate explicit next step, verify the customer’s actual agreement and save accurate notes.

categories.title: Scope and pricing accuracy
categories.coaching: Separate the required initial deep and recurring estimate. Do not invent a discount or final booking.

categories.title: Call structure and control
categories.coaching: Use a relevant question, one concern at a time, and a clear transition. Network waits are not learner delay.

categories.title: Spoken clarity and pacing
categories.coaching: Manager listening required. Coach a specific intelligibility moment with a timestamp and confidence; never score accent identity, health or personality.

nonnegotiables: No claim that a request is a booking or payment
